items.description: Demonstrated fabricated evidence or source answers falsely presented as computed can invalidate the submission. Ordinary failed, missing or incorrect calculations lose only the affected items.
Demonstrated unauthorized hidden evaluator answer access can invalidate the submission; unsupported chemistry alone is an item-level failure.

status_policy: Each final scientific item is pass/fail. Missing, incorrect or insufficient evidence fails only the affected item; independent supported points are retained. There is no need_review outcome.
